name: agent-connector
description: Connects local ACP agents (Claude Code, opencode) to remote channel gateways

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/protocol && rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && chmod +x dist/cli/main.js
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/protocol && npm run typecheck -w packages/protocol && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/protocol && npm test -w packages/protocol && node --test "test/*.test.ts"
